edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve the dispute between them that is the subject of this Agreement (the “Dispute”).

1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD [AMOUNT TO BE AGREED] (the “Settlement Amount”) by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated by Plaintiff in writing within ten business days after execution of this Agreement by both parties.

2. RELEASE. Effective only upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from claims arising from the Dispute. This release does not extend to unrelated claims or claims to enforce this Agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. Each party shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except for disclosures required by law, regulation, or legal process; disclosures to professional advisers who are subject to confidentiality obligations; and disclosures reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement.
